rules.supported: Identity-safe qualifying AllMusic Genre/Styles evidence exists.
rules.sourceSparse: Identity is sufficiently stable, but repeated exact searches have exhausted the qualifying AllMusic taxonomy route.
rules.identityUnresolved: Same-name, composite-credit, or release-credit ambiguity still prevents safe identity linkage.
rules.researchable: A concrete unexhausted source/profile lead remains.

openClassification.explanation: Conservative first overlay: no case is terminally marked source-sparse solely from old triage labels. The 9 profile-or-credit-review plus 21 composite-credit cases seed identity-unresolved; all other 195 open cases remain researchable until review history is explicitly exhausted.

nextPass: Promote cases from researchable to source-sparse only from explicit repeated-search history; do not rerun searches already documented as exhausted.
